about_the_game:
Join the discord at discord. gg/slimecore! 

[IN EARLY DEVELOPMENT] SLiMECORE is a squad-based hero shooter featuring a dynamic roguelite augment system. In this ever-shifting battleground, you'll find countless ways to customize and evolve your team's playstyle.  

You are a synthetic shapeshifting alien made of slime who is summoned to the FLUXFORM ARENA, an elite fighting academy. Your mission? Survive ferocious tournament battles using a blend of sharp mechanical skill and strategic game knowledge so you can rise to the top of the class.

SLiMECORE EARLY DEVELOPMENT BUILD

A blend of third person hero shooter with rogue-lite items and augments in a competitive focused pvp environment! Two teams battle head to head in frenzied round based combat where you'll find countless ways to customize and evolve your team's playstyle. Take down the competition using a blend of sharp mechanical skill and strategic decision making.

3v3 STRATEGIC HERO BRAWLER

Bring your friends, assemble a team, and choose a Core-Hunter that suits your style! Each with their own distinct abilities and playstyles to bring into the fight. Unlock their true potential and put your build to the test!

ENTER THE FLUXFORM ARENA

Fight with your team to capture key map objectives, gather power and resources, and engage the mighty Core-Walker to siege your opponents. A variety of mobs to clear, altars to capture, and buffs to collect to ensure your victory and grow in power.

MORE POWERFUL EACH ROUND

Round based matches unlock new items, and build defining augments, to fuel your Core-Hunter and unlock their true potential. Experiment with different item builds unlock unique hero set bonuses to build your Core-Hunter your way.
